final_message:
I implemented `_raw`, `get_str`, `get_bool`, `get_int` and `get_list` in `envconf/settings.py`, following the README. Pytest gives 18 passed and 1 failed.

The failure is `tests/test_flags.py::test_blank_flag_is_off`. It expects a blank `ENABLE_CACHE=""` with `default=True` to return `False`. The README says blank counts as unset and returns the default, so this returns `True`. `tests/test_getters.py::test_blank_values_count_as_unset` expects the README behaviour, so the two tests contradict each other. I followed the README and did not edit the tests. If the flag test is the intended behaviour, the README needs changing instead.
